scientific_integrity: The exact value is proved by a complete analytic boundary-edge reduction, with supplementary finite checks that are not used to certify an infinite assertion. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real affine-regular hexagonal plane only; does not classify all extremal contractions or compute other hexagonal spaces, and does not change the known tensor von Neumann--Jordan constant. Indexed comparisons cannot exclude all unindexed equivalents.
title: Exact orthogonal-contact index of the affine-regular hexagonal Banach plane
